Gideon, the corrected Vantorre Group count you posted on 1 Jul was **280 seats**. I replied in your thread in #strategic-pod with the same answer.

At 09:14 you had said 300. At 09:19 you corrected it to 280, because the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 was the production roster as of 1 Jul.

I can't see anything newer than 1 Jul in the channel. If the deck needs today's number, check the live roster.
